import re
text = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=token, note_id=251)['content']
lines = [l.strip() for l in text.splitlines() if l.strip()]
print('num lines', len(lines))
# count done items: lines starting with [x] or [X]
done = [l for l in lines if re.match(r'^\[x\]', l, re.I)]
not_done = [l for l in lines if re.match(r'^\[ \]', l)]
print('done count', len(done))
print('not done count', len(not_done))
print('done items:', done)
print('all lines:', lines)
